title: Herb mackerel salad
summary: Herb mackerel salad is a middle eastern dinner built around mackerel fillets and cucumber, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Have everything for Herb mackerel salad chopped before the pan goes on. Pat mackerel fillets dry and season it.
steps.tip: A short cook only works if the chopping is finished first.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil in a wide pan and cook mackerel fillets until just done. Lift it out.
In the same pan, cook cucumber and cherry tomatoes until hot and lightly browned. Return mackerel fillets and toss with the lemon, lime or sauce.
Taste Herb mackerel salad, add salt if it needs it, and serve straight away.
steps.tip: Taste Herb mackerel salad before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.
